description: Case-insensitive regular expressions that must never appear in generated report text, templates or product copy (CLAUDE.md rule 1, docs/claims-and-scope.md, ADR-015). Condition names, normal/abnormal, risk, score, grades and interpretive verbs are the reviewing clinician's to write in the Clinician's assessment, never the system's. Some patterns are written with a character class or group so that this file itself does not trip scripts/lint-claims.sh. The final block guards the claim vocabulary of the 2.5D work (ADR-020): physiological or neurological attribution, named clinical constructs, accuracy claims and change-detection claims are all above the Level A ceiling and are the reviewing clinician's to write, never the system's.
